Affiliate Program Terms & Conditions – Attribution & Promotion Policy

By registering for and participating in the Silkberry Baby Affiliate Program, you agree to comply with the following terms regarding promotional practices and commission eligibility.

1. Eligible Referral Attribution

Affiliate commissions will only be granted for orders that are:

  • Generated through a valid affiliate link
  • Completed by a new or returning customer who has actively clicked the affiliate’s link and completed the purchase within the tracking window
  • Not influenced by prior direct contact with Silkberry Baby

2. Non-Eligible Sales (No Commission)

The following orders will not be attributed to affiliates and are not eligible for commission:

  • Direct Traffic Orders
    Customers who visit silkberrybaby.com directly without clicking an affiliate link.
  • Newsletter & Email Campaign Orders
    Orders placed by customers who receive and respond to Silkberry Baby’s email newsletters, promotional emails, or SMS campaigns.
  • Existing / Loyal Customers
    Orders placed by returning customers who regularly shop with Silkberry Baby, especially those already engaged through our internal marketing channels.
  • Direct Contact Orders
    Customers who contact Silkberry Baby directly (via email, phone, social media, or other channels) and subsequently place orders on our website.
  • Wholesale Orders
    Any wholesale or bulk purchase orders are not eligible for affiliate commissions.

3. Prohibited Promotional Practices

Affiliates are strictly prohibited from engaging in the following practices:

  • Cookie stuffing, forced clicks, or hidden tracking methods
  • Using unauthorized scripts, pop-ups, or embedded code to overwrite or hijack referral tracking
  • Misleading customers into clicking affiliate links
  • Impersonating Silkberry Baby or presenting themselves as the brand
  • Interfering with Silkberry Baby’s marketing channels, including email campaigns or direct customer communications

4. Right to Review & Reverse Commissions

Silkberry Baby reserves the right to:

  • Review and audit any affiliate-referred orders
  • Deny or reverse commissions that violate these terms
  • Suspend or terminate affiliate accounts involved in suspicious or fraudulent activity

5. Final Decision

All decisions regarding order attribution and commission eligibility are made at the sole discretion of Silkberry Baby and are final.
